author: dilpickel
body:
Hello dilpickel here and I bring you my third map!

Sand Plan!

Map Name: Sand Plan
Map Gamemode: Nebula TDM.
Map Creator: dilpickel.

Intro:
In this map players will have to work together to push back the apposing force. Use flank routs to catch the enemy off guard. With speed 2 use it to get an advantage on others. 

Download: (yaml included) 
Separate yaml: 

Info: (per side)
1 large main platform.
16 speed 2 potions.
9 different ways to half.

Teams are ?v?.

ADDED: Color! Red sand now on one side. (I didn't know red sand was added in 1.7 :P)
REMOVED:

Here's some pictures:
http://imgur.com/a/RLzjB(more pics).
